purpose: Separate audio-enabled Doom composite using the ignored local shareware WAD, proven display service, audited Doom SFX adapter, and direct-I2S platform audio API.
runtime_blockers: The new composite has not been authorized, flashed, read back, or hardware-tested.
The E2 verifier is build-only until reusable-backend D2.3 acoustic acceptance and an exact connected-unit one-shot E2 authorization record exist.
The central flash hook, no-reset readback membership, and single deferred-launch membership are intentionally pending.
Controller input remains neutral because the panel cannot safely source controller VBUS without the external protected host shim.
The WAD-bearing local firmware artifact is not authorized for redistribution.
